_meta.note: Illustrative inputs; dates from a 1 Mar 2027 option. OA 2.5%. OA figures are CREDITED balances: interest is credited on 1 Jan and accrued interest is never counted (interest_accrued_not_credited_at_top is information only). Within-month order per A1. loan / min_cash_pct / ltv_route are Stage 2 outputs (A16).

C75.rule: Stage 2 sell_first_conditional: show C75; C75F only as the one-line fallback

A.rule: A1 stress: contributions usable only from the next month
